title: United Air Lines 608
summary: United Air Lines Flight 608 was a Douglas DC-6 airliner, registration NC37510, on a scheduled passenger flight from Los Angeles to Chicago when it crashed at 12:29 pm on October 24, 1947, about 1.5 mi southeast of Bryce Canyon Airport, Utah, United States. All five crew members and 47 passengers on board were killed.
